{{Quote|It is modern, streamlined, high-tech, unbeaten in any conflict since Endor. It has liberated the galaxy from the worst tyranny in known history, and is capable of handling any threat that the New Republic could imagine.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] upon his retirement as [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|New Republic Supreme Commander]], [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]|<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>}}
The '''New Republic Defense Force''', also known as the '''NRDF''', '''New Republic Armed Forces''' or the '''Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic''',<ref name="SOM">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref> were the integrated military forces charged with the defense of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Formed from the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] after the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] reformed into the New Republic in the aftermath of the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the New Republic military went on to [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberate Coruscant]], defeat [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] like [[Ysanne Isard]], [[Zsinj]], and [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], defeat the [[Palpatine/Legends|Reborn Emperor's]] [[Dark Empire]], and finally [[Imperial Skirmishes|defeat]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and end the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

Throughout its history, the New Republic Defense Force also fought numerous local conflicts, including the [[Black Fleet Crisis]] of [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]] and the [[Almanian Uprising]] of [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY]]. After the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the New Republic Defense Force suffered a series of defeats that culminated in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|loss of Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]]. A revitalized Defense Force managed to inflict a devastating defeat on the Yuuzhan Vong at the [[Battle of Ebaq]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]], and was reorganized that year into the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]].

==Role==
The Combined Defense Forces of the New Republic comprised the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]], and until [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[New Republic Army]]. However, all three elements were heavily-integrated, and in contrast to the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] role of planetary invasion and occupation, the New Republic military concentrated on peacekeeping, patrolling, and defense against external attacks. The New Republic military was intended to complement the [[Planetary Security Forces]] that answered to local [[Sector/Legends|sector]] authorities. Consequently the New Republic military was smaller than the Imperial Military that had preceded it (though was much larger than the pre-[[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]), with a focus on rapid response over firepower.<ref name="Warfare" />

The New Republic military's early organization emphasized flexibility, largely owing to the disparate collection of heterogeneous units that had comprised the earlier [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]]. Naval [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] were designed so they could be shifted rapidly within the four main fleets and area commands as required while [[Planetary assault tactics|planetary assault]] became the most common mission profile. The [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] were reorganized as bridgehead commandos while a larger [[New Republic Army]] was created for peacekeeping and garrison duties. Integration and standardization proceeded apace after [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] and the defeat of Warlord [[Zsinj]], with a more serious military reform in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] after the defeat of the [[Dark Empire]], with all federal military forces coming under the control of the four main fleet commands as part of a fully-integrated Defense Force. This period saw the abolition of the [[New Republic Army]], with its defensive responsibilities shifted to the [[Planetary Security Forces]] and the role of planetary assault taken by the [[New Republic Marine]]s. In the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], battle groups became subcommands with defined sectors, with larger forces blockading the main Imperial holdouts and smaller [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] assigned to peacekeeping patrols inside New Republic territory.<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
===From Endor to Coruscant===
[[File:New_Republic_Advances.png|thumb|left|250px|The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] advance to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].]]
After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the former Rebellion's military consisted primarily of donated [[Starship/Legends|starships]] converted to military duty, volunteer resistance force fleets, and a small number of vessels purchased with limited [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] funds, headed by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]. As the Rebel Alliance reformed into the [[Alliance of Free Planets]], and one month later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Ackbar worked to forge his forces into a centralized military that could accomplish the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council's]] primary goal: the capture of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and the liberation of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A decisive moment was [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma's]] issue of the [[Defense Declarations]], which proclaimed the New Republic's intent to devolve control of the [[Planetary Security Forces]], nationalized by the Empire, back to the sectors. Admiral Ackbar would later describe the Declarations as more decisive in delivering worlds from the Empire than any military campaign: members of the new government would be expected to support the common military, but could also now control their own planetary defense forces and at greater strength than under the Empire or the Republic. Imperial loyalist sectors dismissed the measure as illegal, but for others the Declarations caused many sectors that had been on the edge to side with the New Republic. Other sectors divided over whether to accept the Declarations, fomenting further Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlordism]] and infighting and significantly reducing the number of enemies the New Republic had to fight.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

Early campaigns for the New Republic military included the unexpected [[Ssi-ruuvi invasions|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruu]]k at [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], and the [[Nagai–Tof War|war]] between the [[Extragalactic/Legends|extra-galactic]] [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] and [[Tof/Legends|Tofs]], who advanced as far as [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]] before the Tofs were [[Battle of Zeltros|defeated]], and finally expelled from the galaxy at the [[Battle of Saijo]]. The campaigns stretched the New Republic military to the breaking point, and so it would not make any overt military moves against the Empire until over six months after Endor, but had reassured citizens that the former Rebellion could defend the galaxy and legitimized the new government. It was at this time that the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] created its four original fleets: the [[New Republic First Fleet|First Fleet]] under the command of Admiral [[Firmus Nantz]] operated out of [[Saijo/Legends|Saijo]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]; the [[New Republic Second Fleet|Second Fleet]] under Admiral [[Hiram Drayson/Legends|Hiram Drayson]] defended the New Republic's redoubt in the [[Calamari sector/Legends|Calamari sector]]; the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third Fleet]] operated out of [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] into [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] under Ackbar's personal command; and the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fouth Fleet]] under Admiral [[Voon Massa]] operated from Bothawui along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] as a mobile reserve for the First and Third Fleets. Flexibility was the guiding principle for the Defense Force's organization in this period, with pre-existing [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] from the old [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] remaining intact and local loyalties being taken into account. [[Battle group/Legends|Battle groups]] were designed so they could be shifted within the four main fleets as required or if necessary deployed independently.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="NEC" />

[[File:RebelVictoryAtCoruscant.jpg|thumb|right|150px|New Republic troopers during the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].]]
Over the next two years, the New Republic military fought a complex campaign aimed at isolating and marginalizing Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] from the rump of the Empire in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Nantz's First Fleet separated warlords [[Sander Delvardus|Delvardus]] and [[Utoxx Prentioch|Prentioch]] in an [[operation on Abraxas|operation]] on [[Abraxas]] and isolated [[Par Lankin]] in the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]] in the [[Hevvrol Sector Campaign]]. Massa's Fourth Fleet [[Battle of Druckenwell (Galactic Civil War)|captured Druckenwell]] while Admiral Ackbar personally led the Third Fleet to [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberate Kashyyyk]] and, with [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|capture Brentaal IV]], bringing the New Republic into the Core Worlds. [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], however, saw morale fall as the New Republic was embroiled in attritional slogs on [[Milagro/Legends|Milagro]] and [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]: the [[New Republic Army]] and the Fourth Fleet engaged in both a surface and subterranean struggle against Admiral [[Uther Kermen]]'s [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] and [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper]] forces in the [[Milagro campaign]], while [[General/Legends|General]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] led the [[Rapid Response Task Force]] to assist the Third Fleet against [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn]] at the [[Battle of Mindor]]. A needed lift came with the [[Delvardus campaign]], which saw the First Fleet collapse the border of Warlord Delvardus' dominion and force him to flee into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="NEC" />

The New Republic consolidated its holdings in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], with the First Fleet eliminating Warlord Prentioch's [[Prentioch's Dominion|dominion]] at the [[Siege of Bomis Koori]] and the Fourth Fleet [[Battle of Denon (Galactic Civil War)|capturing Denon]] in a savage battle that saw the death of Admiral Massa. Meanwhile, Admiral Ackbar encircled the Core Worlds from the north in preparation for the capture of Coruscant, winning battles at [[Battle of Uviuy Exen (6 ABY)|Uviuy Exen]] and [[Battle of Drearia (6 ABY)|Drearia]], before launching the [[Core Campaign]] in mid-6 ABY. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] fought [[First Battle of Borleias|twin]] [[Second Battle of Borleias|battles]] to capture [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] as a stepping stone to Coruscant itself, and finally [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberated]] the galactic capital from the self-proclaimed Empress [[Ysanne Isard]] several weeks later.<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="NEC" />

===Against Thrawn and the Reborn Emperor===
After the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|capture of Coruscant]], the New Republic reorganized under the [[New Republic Common Charter|Common Charter]], which also organized the military might of the New Republic into a single unified command structure. Starships, [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and soldiers all served under the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], an office built from the remains of the [[Minister of Defense (Republic)|Minister of Defense]], [[Minister of the Army]], [[Minister of the Navy]] and [[Minister of the Starfighter Corps]]. The Defense Force was also under [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]]. While the Defense Force was organized into [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]], Intelligence, Technology and Quartermaster sections, the Defense Fleet served as its primary action body, and was led directly by the Supreme Commander, Ackbar. Many also referred to the Defense Fleet as the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]].

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], the [[Solo Fleet]], an independent task force under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], was deployed to [[Hunt for Zsinj|defeat]] Warlord [[Zsinj]], the most powerful of the independent Imperial warlords. Zsinj was forced into hiding after the [[Battle of Selaggis]] and was subsequently killed at the [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|Battle of Dathomir]]. Despite Zsinj's death, however, [[Post–Zsinj campaigns|in the fighting that followed]] to claim [[Zsinj's Empire|his empire]], the New Republic took significant casualties from both Warlord [[Treuten Teradoc|Teradoc]] and Admiral [[Teren Rogriss]], leading forces out of [[Imperial Space]]. Though Teradoc was forced to retreat into the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], fleet numbers on both sides largely stabilized owing to the losses of the campaigns, and at the end of [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] Mon Mothma ordered a suspension in military operations, leaving the New Republic in nominal control of three-quarters of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], having pushed the Galactic Empire into a rump state in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] beyond the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]].<ref name="Warfare" /><ref name="Atlas" /><ref name="NEC" />

Grand Admiral Thrawn returned in 9 ABY from his expedition in the unknown regions(where he founded The Empire of The Hand), and with handful of ships at the start of his campaign was able to gather a large armada and nearly defeated the New Republic if not for his guard's betrayal at the battle of Bilbringi.

===Fighting the Imperial Remnant===
[[File:Darksaber.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The New Republic [[Battle for the Darksaber|engages]] the [[Darksaber (superweapon)|Darksaber]] in the Hoth Asteroid Field]]
Ostensibly it was during this period that the navy began to organize into [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]]. Each of the four fleets now consisted of hundreds of warships, transports, and support vessels organized into [[Battle group/Legends|battle groups]] and [[Task force/Legends|task forces]], in addition to ground troop divisions and starfighter wings. These fleets patrolled segments of the New Republic on a rotating basis, with at least one always assigned to defending Coruscant and another assigned to patrolling "[[Thunder Alley]]." Prior to [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], four fleets existed to fulfill this function.
[[File:BattleOfYagDhul.jpg|thumb|left|200px|New Republic forces during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]]]
In the nine years following the reorganization of the fleet, the variety of vessels that comprised the Defense Fleet grew; starships from hundreds of shipyards across New Republic space made up the frontline, support and civilian vessels of the Fleet. The resulting inefficiencies of this diversity prompted a program to streamline the Fleet's ships and increase maintenance efficiency. This program, named [[New Class Modernization Program|New Class]], offered the Fleet a new level of standardization, power and flexibility previously enjoyed by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Starfleet]]. By [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]], a new battle group, the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Battle Group]] constructed wholly of New Class starships completed its proving missions and demonstrated the success of the program in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]].

===The Yuuzhan Vong War and end===
However, the Fleet's battle groups were designed as response forces and, despite the concerns of some politicians during the launch of the Fifth Battle Group, not a tool of conquest. Thus, the Fleet was woefully unprepared to launch counteroffensives against the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in the early stages of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and once again had to rely on its talented commanders to achieve victories. Unfortunately, the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] kept withdrawing fleets to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], effectively forcing the Defense Force to sacrifice the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. The Defense Force suffered serious defeats due to the political leadership, draining morale and resources, and members of the Defense Force came close to mutiny.

With the collapse of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the formation of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], the New Republic Defense Force formally ceased to exist, and was replaced by the [[Galactic Alliance Defense Force]].

==Organization==
===Headquarters===
The Defense Forces were headed by the [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], who took orders from the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], the civilian leader of the New Republic. In the first few years after [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Endor]], the Defense Forces were organized under the Ministry of Defense, which had been reorganized from the Rebel Alliance's [[Ministry of War (Alliance)|Ministry of War]], with separate ministries below for the [[New Republic Army|Army]], [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|Fleet]], and [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|Starfighter Corps]]. In practice this proved overly-bureaucratic and cumbersome, and following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the whole command structure was reorganized again, with the position of Minister of Defense being abolished and the Supreme Commander becoming a [[New Republic Ruling Council|Ruling Council]] position. [[New Republic High Command/Legends|New Republic High Command]] was the senior professional military body in control of the Defense Forces, which in turn controlled [[Fleet Command (New Republic)/Legends|Fleet Command]]<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref> and [[New Republic Starfighter Command/Legends|Starfighter Command]].<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

Legislative scrutiny of defense policy was conducted by the [[Senate Defense Council/Legends|Defense Council]] of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].<ref name="BTS" />

===Administrative organization===
The branches of the New Republic military before integration were the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]], [[New Republic Starfighter Corps/Legends|New Republic Starfighter Corps]], and the [[New Republic Army]]. Federal military forces were fully integrated into the four fleet commands in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], with the Army being abolished and its responsibilities transferred to the Defense Fleet's [[New Republic Marine|Marines]] and the ground elements of the [[Planetary Security Forces]].<ref name="Warfare" />

Other administrative departments within the Defense Forces included the [[Technology Section]], the [[Training Section]], the [[Quartermaster/Legends|Quartermaster]] Section, [[New Republic Special Operations]], [[New Republic Special Forces/Legends|New Republic Special Forces]], and the [[New Republic Fleet Office]].<ref name="NJOSourcebook">''[[The New Jedi Order Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[New Republic Fleet Intelligence]] was the military intelligence branch of the Defense Force, and was a separate agency to the civilian [[New Republic Intelligence Service]].<ref name="BTS" /> The [[New Republic Honor Guard]] provided ceremonial duties.<ref name="Jedi Search">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref>

===Tactical organization===
The Defense Forces were built around four main fleets and area commands, derived from the four original fleets that had conducted the advance on Coruscant from [[4 ABY/Legends|4]] to [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Early organization emphasized flexibility, with pre-existing [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and [[Flotilla/Legends|flotillas]] from the old [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] remaining intact and local loyalties being taken into account. [[Battle group/Legends|Battle groups]] were designed so they could be shifted within the four main fleets as required or if necessary deployed independently, such as the [[Solo Fleet]] deployed against [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]].<ref name="Warfare" />

As the New Republic grew, Admiral Ackbar was faced with the challenge of creating a unified Defense Force out of the disparate units that had comprised the Rebel Alliance's [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], which had contrasting regulations, tactics and traditions. To achieve this, the squadrons that had not originally been part of the central Alliance [[Rebel Fleet Command/Legends|Fleet Command]] were largely broken up and their ships and crews sent to different units. This provoked a degree of resistance, but on the whole Defense Force integration proceeded quickly. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic First Fleet]] guarded [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as the Home Fleet, while the [[New Republic Second Fleet|Second]] defended [[Elom (planet)/Legends|Elom]], the [[New Republic Third Fleet|Third]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[New Republic Fourth Fleet|Fourth]], [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]]. This arrangement fought in the [[Thrawn campaign]], the Imperial [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|advance]] out of the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], and [[Operation Shadow Hand]].<ref name="Warfare" />

By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] the [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] and [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] forces met standards for strength, unity and discipline, allowing a more sweeping military reform. The [[New Republic Army]], which had suffered heavy casualties in Operation Shadow Hand, was abolished, with its defense and garrison responsibilities transferred to the local [[Planetary Security Forces]], and all federal military forces were placed under the four fleet commands as part of a integrated Defense Force. Naval battle groups became subcommands with defined sectors of operations, with large forces blockading the main Imperial holdouts and smaller squadrons assigned to peacekeeping patrols inside New Republic territory. One battle group in each fleet served as a mobile reserve, but temporary attachments of multi-role task forces&mdash;standardized squadrons built around a mix of vessels with complementary capabilities&mdash;could turn each battle group into a powerful fighting fleet.<ref name="Warfare" />

After the reorganization led to the four fleets becoming increasingly tied-down as territorial deployments, a new rapid-reaction command was activated in [[16 ABY/Legends|16 ABY]]. The [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|Fifth Roving Battle Group]] contained five task forces, and fought with distinction in the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. The Fifth Battle Group was soon assigned full fleet status, and by [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet]] was enlarged to a full strength of five hundred [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in five battle groups.<ref name="Warfare" />
